featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's Claude Code lead Boris Cherny shared the sharpest engineering artifact of the day: he used Opus 5.5 with Lean to formally verify the Claude Agent SDK, and a couple of short prompts produced 16 PRs fixing assorted bugs and race conditions. He also uses TLA+, sometimes combining both to hunt for data flow, concurrency and state management issues. He admits he doesn't know either language well, but the model is excellent at both, which is the real point: formal verification has been shelved by most teams…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 这两天丢出了今天最硬的一条工程实践：他用 Opus 5.5 配合 Lean 对 Claude Agent SDK 做了形式化验证，几个简短的 prompt 就产出了 16 个 PR，修掉了一批 bug 和竞态条件。他同时也用 TLA+，有时两者混用来排查数据流、并发和状态管理上的问题。他坦承自己并不精通这两种语言，但模型两样都很擅长——这恰恰是关键：形式化验证过去因为门槛太高而被工程团队束之高阁，模型把门槛拉平之后，它可能成为找 bug 的主流手段。他抛了个开放问题：形式化验证是不是编程（至少是找 bug）的未来？另一条实测更直白：他们让 Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 各自把 HAProxy 从 C 移植到 Rust，两者都通过了几乎全部测试，但 Opus 5.5 用 9.5 小时完成，对比 Fable 5.1 的 12 小时，成本还低 51%。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux announced the release of GPT-6 Sol and Luna. He frames it as a significant improvement across the board, plus a step up in writing and that "you know when you try it" quality. The commercial move matters more for enterprises: API prices are being permanently cut by 50%, which he argues makes both models viable for a swathe of new use cases while stretching subscription usage further, and Plus, Pro and Business accounts get a banked usage reset. He also explained th…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 发布。他强调这不只是横向的全面提升，写作质量和那种"用过才知道"的手感也有明显进步。商业层面更值得企业注意：API 价格永久下调 50%，他认为这让这两个模型对大量新场景具备了可行性，同时也让订阅用户的额度更经用；Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户还会拿到一次额度重置。他补充了团队的路线逻辑——能在效率和普惠智能上做出大幅改进，前提是你先在能力上限那头有足够强的模型可用，再拿它去改善其余的一切。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie called the day for what it is: with Opus 5.5 price cuts landing alongside a 50% token price drop for GPT-6 Sol and Luna, frontier models just got substantially cheaper in a single day. His core argument is that the rate at which cost per task falls in AI is unlike any other technology in history, and every drop dramatically widens the set of use cases you can deploy agents against. This is Jevons paradox applied to agents. Concretely: processing all your data, scanning code for security issues,…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 给今天下了个定性判断：Opus 5.5 降价加上 GPT-6 Sol/Luna 的 token 价格腰斩，前沿模型在同一天大幅变便宜了。他的核心论点是——AI 单位任务成本的下降速度在技术史上没有先例，而每一次成本下降，能够部署 agent 的场景就急剧扩大，这是 agent 版本的杰文斯悖论。落到具体：用 agent 处理全部数据、扫描代码安全问题、读完所有日志再做决策、在工作流里跑 agent 集群——这些用例能不能规模化，直接和 token 成本挂钩。他还给出了 Box 自己的实测数据，含金量比口号高得多：在复杂企业知识工作任务上，Opus 5.5 相比 Opus 5 少用 63% token、少 42% 冗余表述、快 30%。分行业看，金融服务尽调任务准确率 +39%（token 消耗少 82%），科技行业云成本分析 +65%，消费品客户账户分析 +17%，临床诊断数据分析 +15%——最后这项里，模型自己发现两组数据标准差差了 100 倍以上，换了正确方法重算，结论随之被推翻。

items.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 产品
items.summaryEn: Cat Wu, who works on Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, laid out the defaulting details for Opus 5.5: it is now the default model in Claude Code and the Claude app, including Cowork, for Pro, Max and Team plans. Three details are worth noting. Effort is set to medium across products, which is comparable to Fable 5.1 on intelligence but faster; rate limits go 25% further on Opus 5.5 than on Opus 5; and in her own daily use the standouts are clear communication and the ability to write in her style. Her suggestion…
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队的 Cat Wu 公布了 Opus 5.5 的默认化细节：它现在是 Claude Code 和 Claude 应用（包括 Cowork）在 Pro、Max、Team 套餐下的默认模型。三个细节值得留意——全线产品默认 effort 设为 medium，在智能水平上大致对标 Fable 5.1 但更快；相同额度下 Opus 5.5 比 Opus 5 能多跑 25%；她本人日常使用的体感是沟通表达更清晰，并且能模仿她自己的写作风格。她的建议很简单：给它一个野心大的任务试试。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq of Anthropic's Claude Code team offered the most useful counter-note amid the launch noise, and it is aimed squarely at managers: the right way to use improved model capabilities is not to ship 10x more features to prod. It is to spend more time understanding your users, running experiments, building prototypes and learning about things you don't understand, so that you ship things that actually work. The post drew one of the day's highest engagement counts at 4.5k likes and 313 retweets. He added that work…
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 的 Thariq 在一片发布噪音里给出了今天最值得管理者听的反调：模型能力变强了，正确的用法不是往生产环境多塞 10 倍的功能，而是把省下来的时间花在更深地理解用户、做实验、搭原型、补自己的认知盲区上——这样你交付的东西才真的有用。这条获得了当天最高的转发量之一（4.5k 赞、313 转），说明共鸣者众。他还提到 workflow 现在是他使用 Claude 的主要方式，而"Fable 级别的智能能以可接受的成本跑 workflow"是这件事成立的前提。另外给做游戏的人一句提醒（他说是对自己说的）：3D 生成确实能帮你把游戏想象具象化，但你得先把一个好玩、有满足感的游戏循环想清楚。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch published a fresh round of Next.js evals: Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Fable 5.1 all tied at 97%, with Grok 4.7 at 94%. He pointed out that Grok is 2x to 7x cheaper, which is a real variable for cost-sensitive batch workloads. He also landed a quotable line: "Software will never die again. You liked Google Reader? Cool, you can generate and deploy your own. Yours, forever." He closed by praising the tastefulness with which Anthropic ships, tying it back to why he got excited about headless fo…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 放出了新一轮 Next.js evals 的成绩：Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Sol、Fable 5.1 三者并列 97%，Grok 4.7 为 94%——他特意点出 Grok 便宜 2 到 7 倍，这在成本敏感的批量场景里是个真实变量。他还给了一句很有传播力的判断："软件不会再死掉了。你喜欢 Google Reader？那就自己生成一个部署上去，永远属于你。"最后他称赞了 Anthropic 发布时的品味，并顺势说了他当初看好 headless web 的原因：任何一个页面都可以长成你想要的奇特或独特形状，而有了 AI 之后，没有理由不去推设计的边界。

items.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic 研究员
items.summaryEn: Anthropic researcher Alex Albert demonstrated the step change in Opus 5.5's 3D modeling and vision: better 3D plus better vision means you can build an entire world from a single prompt. His example is a historically accurate San Francisco Market Street on the afternoon before the 1906 earthquake. The transferable lesson is that he wrote the prompt as a research specification rather than an instruction. He required the model to first build a source file from the 1899-1905 Sanborn fire insurance maps, the Miles Bro…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 研究员 Alex Albert 展示了 Opus 5.5 在 3D 建模和视觉能力上的跃迁：更强的 3D 建模加上视觉理解，意味着你可以从一个 prompt 构建一整个世界。他的样例是历史考据级别的 1906 年地震前夕的旧金山 Market Street。值得学习的是他把 prompt 写成了一份研究规范而非一句指令：先要求模型基于 1899–1905 年 Sanborn 火险地图、Miles 兄弟 1906 年的影片《A Trip Down Market Street》、OpenSFHistory 与国会图书馆及 David Rumsey 收藏的时代照片、以及 USGS 地形数据建立一份 source file，为每栋建筑记录占地、高度、立面材质、业主，并为每条事实标注来源和置信度；然后要求全部用 Blender Python 生成，不许下载任何现成网格、贴图或 HDRI，必须写可复用的生成器（维多利亚式商业立面、孟莎屋顶、凸窗、遮阳篷、手绘招牌、煤气与电街灯、缆车、马车、早期汽车），再从 source file 装配出整条街——这样每栋楼都能追溯回数据。这是一份可以直接拿去改写成企业级 agent…

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · SPC 合伙人、Bevel Health 联合创始人
items.summaryEn: SPC general partner and Bevel Health co-founder Aditya Agarwal, previously an early Facebook engineer and Dropbox CTO, offered a historical marker that is easy to miss: today's safety and alignment debate is almost entirely about models, but the original AI and machine learning safety debate happened in autonomous vehicles. After hosting Waymo's Dmitri Dolgov, he said the most interesting part was the extensive eval and testing infrastructure Waymo built to gain the confidence to release two-ton robots traveling a…
items.insightZh: SPC 合伙人、Bevel Health 联合创始人 Aditya Agarwal（前 Facebook 早期工程师、Dropbox CTO）提了个容易被忽略的历史坐标：今天 AI 安全与对齐的争论几乎全围绕"模型"，但最早的 AI/机器学习安全辩论其实发生在自动驾驶领域。他主持 Waymo 的 Dmitri Dolgov 对谈后认为，最有意思的部分是 Waymo 为了有信心把两吨重、时速 30 英里的机器人放到城市道路上，所建起来的那套庞大的 eval 与测试基础设施——这对当下所有想把 agent 放进生产环境的企业是直接的方法论参照。他还提醒了另一件事：在对生产力的狂奔中，人们常常忘了 AI 产品也应该是令人愉悦和好玩的。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari offered the least fun but possibly most practical private-markets reminder of the day: the volume of SPVs organized by even the "best" investors is mind boggling, to the point that when you read a headline about a large fundraise you can now reasonably assume a large share of it came from SPVs even though the headline says otherwise. Combine that with tranched valuations and inconsistent definitions of revenue, and his conclusion is blunt: don't believe the headlines anymore. Th…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 给了今天最"扫兴"但可能最实用的一条一级市场提醒：即便是所谓"最好的"投资人，组织 SPV 的规模也大到令人咋舌，以至于现在看到大额融资的标题新闻，你基本可以合理推断其中相当一部分资金来自 SPV，尽管标题不会这么写。再叠加分期估值（tranched valuations）以及"收入"口径的不一致，他的结论直白："别再相信标题了。"而验证的材料根本不对外公开。对需要判断合作方或竞品真实融资实力的人来说，这条值得钉在墙上。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 与 OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger of OpenClaw and OpenAI contributed a small but persuasive datapoint: after updating to macOS 27, ChatGPT would sometimes crash on him, and Astra tracked it down to a roughly 14-year-old bug in libuv. Low-frequency crashes buried in aging low-level libraries are exactly the class of problem that usually gets shelved because reproduction is too expensive, which makes it one of the highest-yield use cases for model-assisted debugging.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 与 OpenAI 的 Peter Steinberger 贡献了一个小而有说服力的实例：他升级到 macOS 27 之后 ChatGPT 偶尔崩溃，让 Astra 去查，结果在 libuv 里挖出了一个存在了约 14 年的 bug。这类"陈年底层库里的低频崩溃"过去往往因为复现成本太高而被长期搁置，是模型辅助排查最有实际收益的场景之一。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator president and CEO Garry Tan shared a shift in his own stack: he is using Capy (capy.ai) and says it lets him drop PRs much faster than he would with Codex or Claude Code alone. Note the framing is additive, not a replacement. He also mentioned GStack, his own project, alongside a broader claim: we need to teach the world to prompt and maximally use AI so that all people can see how it gives them wings in their pursuits, and then we need to yearn to solve more problems for ourselves and for one another.
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 分享了他自己的工具栈变化：他在用 Capy（capy.ai），称它让自己提交 PR 的速度比单用 Codex 或 Claude Code 快得多——注意他的措辞是"叠加"而非"替代"。他同时提了自己做的 GStack，以及一个更大的主张：我们需要教会全世界怎么写 prompt、怎么最大化利用 AI，让所有人看到它如何能在各自的追求中给人插上翅膀；然后我们需要渴望为自己、也为彼此解决更多问题。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper noted he added almost 10,000 new followers in a day and pointed newcomers to two starting points: his vibe check comparing Opus 5.5 against Sol-6, and his argument that after automation, AI creates more good work to do for human experts. The second is the more useful one inside a company, because it offers a second organizational design frame beyond the standard automation narrative.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 表示当天涨了近一万新关注者，并为新读者指了两篇他认为最值得先看的东西：一是他对 Opus 5.5 与 Sol-6 的横向实测体感（vibe check），二是他关于"AI 自动化之后，反而为人类专家创造了更多值得做的好工作"的立论。后者在企业里尤其值得一读——它给出的是自动化叙事之外的第二种组织设计思路。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang, who creates practical AI tutorials and interviews for a 110,000-subscriber audience, said Opus 5.5 is the most excited he has been about a Claude model in a while and explained why in his own channels. Given that his audience is non-specialist, this is a useful secondary signal for how much of the new model's improvement is actually perceptible to ordinary users.
items.insightZh: 拥有 11 万订阅者的 AI 教程与访谈创作者 Peter Yang 表示，Opus 5.5 是他很久以来对 Claude 模型最兴奋的一次，并在自己的渠道里详细讲了原因。考虑到他的内容面向的是非专业读者，这条可以作为判断新模型在普通用户侧体感差异的一个旁证。

items.title: Claude 官方账号 · Anthropic
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official Claude account confirmed Opus 5.5 shipped the same day and showcased a few small apps that mark the new capability boundary: an algorithmic drawing program by Kevin Ngo where every drawing is based on a different seed, and a toy brick-building app that turns a photo or a description into a buildable model with custom instructions. Both point the same direction: generating structured, executable artifacts from a single input is getting meaningfully better.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 的 Claude 官方账号确认 Opus 5.5 当日上线，并放出了几个展示新能力边界的小应用：一个由 Kevin Ngo 制作的算法绘图程序，每张图基于不同的随机种子生成；以及一个积木搭建应用，可以把一张照片或一段文字描述变成可实际拼搭的模型并附带说明书。两者都指向同一个方向——从单一输入生成结构化、可执行产物的能力在变强。
